dataset.permissions: Repository-authored synthetic sources, students and time; no private data.
dataset.reuse: Six concepts and driver reused from 025; fresh seed histories, not independent held-out validation.
dataset.rationale: Full persona/family grid with three repeats, intended as bounded regression coverage, not powered learning-effect inference.

limitations: Deterministic generation and planning; zero external LLM calls.
Operational evidence thresholds are not calibrated mastery or instructor approval.
Same-template histories are dependent; goal fractions have no population confidence interval.
Final-DB audit cannot disambiguate equal virtual timestamps; exact commit boundaries are covered by service tests.
No automatic rewrite of historical completed goals.
Provider-backed final composition and real-student learning are not requalified.

configuration.objective_binding: exact objective, all required concepts, committed state only

limitations: Final database audit cannot disambiguate commits with identical virtual timestamps.
A completion is supported if one same-student/course/release conversation has eligible evidence; conversations are never pooled.
Operational evidence eligibility is not human mastery or a pedagogical quality score.
